clue.text: At one time the premier city of England

definitions.meaning: the Marquess of ... was Britain's Prime Minister three times in the late Victorian era
a cathedral city in Wiltshire, in the south of England

explanation.surface: A claim that some English city once held top rank in the country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Premier' looks like an adjective for the city, but it is a noun: a prime minister, here the Victorian Lord Salisbury.
explanation.definitionFit: The title-holder and the cathedral city share one name, so a former prime minister and a Wiltshire city both fit.

clue.text: Going over the head, branch out

definitions.text: Going over the head, branch out

parts.words: Going over the head, branch out
parts.note: describes the bony growths a stag carries above its skull, which divide into points

explanation.definitionFit: A deer's branched horn grows from the top of its skull.

clue.text: Distinctive characters with a leaning towards the right

definitions.text: Distinctive characters with a leaning towards the right

parts.words: Distinctive characters with a leaning towards the right
parts.note: sounds like people with conservative politics, but describes printed letters that slope to the right

explanation.definitionFit: Sloping typeface used for emphasis, whose letters slant rightwards.

clue.text: A blow for people requiring refreshment

definitions.meaning: a punch or a battering, as from wind
a counter or spread where people help themselves to food and drink

explanation.surface: A punch is served to people who want a snack.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blow' suggests a punch drink at a party, but means a strike.
explanation.definitionFit: A strike or knock, and also a self-service meal laid out on a table.

clue.text: In the pink, so got up and made a meal

parts.note: rose means got up out of bed
ate means had food, made a meal

explanation.surface: Someone feeling healthy rose from bed and cooked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the pink' suggests good health, but means rosy-coloured.
explanation.definitionFit: Rose-coloured, tinged with a soft pinkish hue.

clue.text: Swollen-faced and dull

definitions.meaning: read literally, having a fat, puffy head

explanation.surface: Someone is puffy in the face and slow.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally with a plump head, and in slang meaning stupid or dim.

clue.text: Feller is a worker who moves clumsily?

parts.note: to lumber is to move heavily and awkwardly
a man is a worker or employee

explanation.surface: A fellow is described as an awkward, plodding labourer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Feller' looks like slang for fellow, but means one who fells trees.
explanation.definitionFit: A logger who cuts down trees for timber.

clue.text: A keeper before a waiter

parts.note: pre means before, as a prefix
a server waits on tables

explanation.surface: A goalkeeper arrives ahead of a waiter.
explanation.definitionFit: One who guards or maintains something, keeping it safe from harm.

clue.text: He considers precious few a lure, being dubious

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral five, taken here as a few

indicators.note: dubious means doubtful or suspect, so these letters are not to be trusted in their printed order

explanation.surface: Someone thinks a few precious things make a doubtful bait.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being dubious' rearranges A LURE into ALUER, which follows V.
explanation.definitionFit: An appraiser weighs up how precious objects are and puts a price on them.

clue.text: Firm making place secure

parts.note: stead means place, as in 'in his stead'
fast means firmly fixed, as in 'made fast'

explanation.surface: A company is fortifying its premises.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Firm' looks like a noun, a business, but it is the adjective meaning resolute.
explanation.definitionFit: Both describe someone unwavering and resolute in loyalty or purpose.

clue.text: A fine old metropolis — almost the finest of all

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the final letter of the phrase is cut off

parts.note: best means finest of all, the top of the range

explanation.surface: Praise for a grand ancient city that very nearly tops the list.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' drops the last T from THE BEST.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient capital of Egypt, and another in Greece, was one of the great cities of the old world.

clue.text: A veil made for disguise in the middle ages

indicators.note: a disguise changes how something looks, so the letters are dressed up in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone wore a veil as a disguise back in the middle ages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for disguise' rearranges A VEIL MADE; the veil looks like part of the period scene.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes anything belonging to the period between antiquity and the Renaissance.

clue.text: Less prejudiced, but distant — holding in anger

indicators.note: holding in means keeping inside, so one word is placed within the other

parts.note: far means distant
ire means anger

explanation.surface: Someone is fairer but remote, bottling up rage.
explanation.definitionFit: A more impartial judge is one with less bias, more even-handed.

clue.text: Suggesting professional modelling

parts.note: pro is short for professional
posing means modelling for an artist or camera

explanation.surface: Hinting that someone models for a living.
explanation.definitionFit: Putting forward an idea or plan for consideration.

clue.text: Growing source of breakfast-food?

parts.note: read as plants that grow eggs for breakfast, though it means aubergines

explanation.definitionFit: The American name for aubergines, purple vegetables that grow on bushes.

clue.text: Put off a date maybe without the right

indicators.note: without in its old sense means outside, so one piece surrounds the other
maybe means perhaps, so these letters may be arranged another way

parts.note: a lien is a legal right to hold property until a debt is paid

explanation.surface: A suitor was deterred from a possible date with no rights.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maybe' rearranges A DATE into AATED, and 'without' (outside) places it round LIEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Estranged, turned away, made unfriendly or hostile.

clue.text: A key must be presented to the queen always

parts.note: E is one of the musical keys
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the late Queen

explanation.surface: A key has to be handed over to the monarch for good.
explanation.walkthrough: 'must be presented to' just places E before ER. The answer is the poetic contraction of 'ever'.
explanation.definitionFit: A poetic shortening of ever, meaning at all times, forever.

clue.text: Showing a certain hesitation over a lengthy period

indicators.note: in a down answer, over means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: er is the sound of hesitating
taken as written; that the answer's letters also run through the words over a is a coincidence, as over is the positional indicator

explanation.surface: Someone hesitates for a long time.
explanation.definitionFit: An age or epoch, a long span of history.

clue.text: Degenerate rock-climber

indicators.note: a climber goes upwards, so in a down answer the word for rock reads from bottom to top

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hill or outcrop

explanation.surface: A rock climber is called a degenerate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'climber' sends TOR upwards in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: To decay, decompose, go bad.

clue.text: Uniform of the long-serving soldier

definitions.meaning: describes a professional soldier in the standing army, as opposed to a reservist

explanation.surface: A remark about the dress worn by a veteran soldier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Uniform' looks like the soldier's kit, but it is an adjective meaning consistent.
explanation.definitionFit: Even and unvarying, and also the word for a full-time professional in the standing army.

clue.text: Love to go on about oriental work

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, shaped like O

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece wraps round the other

parts.note: prate means to chatter on at tedious length
E is short for eastern, oriental

explanation.surface: A lover keeps talking about something from the East.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts E inside PRATE to make PERATE, which follows O.
explanation.definitionFit: To run or function, as a machine or a business does.

clue.text: Expertise in a particular trade

indicators.note: in means the letters sit inside the run of the next two words

explanation.surface: Skill in a specialised line of business.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters are lodged across particulAR Trade.
explanation.definitionFit: Skill or craft acquired through practice, as in the art of negotiation.

clue.text: Send back note on a poet's output

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale
verse is what a poet writes

explanation.surface: Return a note about a poet's work.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' means sitting on top of, so the note comes first; 'Send back' suggests mail, but the sense is turning about.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn back the other way, to back up or go backwards.

clue.text: Spray the capsicum

definitions.meaning: to pelt or shower with shot or missiles
the sweet or hot fruit of the capsicum plant

explanation.surface: An instruction to mist the bell pepper plant.
explanation.definitionFit: To pelt with shot, and also the name of the sweet capsicum vegetable.

clue.text: Credit is one's solution when there's real emergency

parts.note: taken as written
one is I, and 's adds S

explanation.surface: Borrowing money is someone's answer when there's an emergency.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one's' gives I plus S.
explanation.definitionFit: A time of acute danger or difficulty, a critical moment.

clue.text: Change planes in Italy

indicators.note: change means make different, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Advice to switch flights while in Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Change' rearranges PLANES; the definition is a place in Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: A large port city in southern Italy, on the bay below Vesuvius.

clue.text: This should be a spirited meeting!

definitions.text: This should be a spirited meeting!

parts.words: This should be a spirited meeting!
parts.note: spirited suggests lively, but here means a gathering attended by spirits of the dead

explanation.definitionFit: A gathering where a medium tries to contact ghosts of the departed.

clue.text: Expects too much of public cuts

parts.note: overt means open and public, not hidden
axes means cuts, as in budget cuts

explanation.surface: Public spending cuts ask too much of people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'public cuts' reads as one phrase about budgets but splits into two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To put excessive strain or demands on someone, as with too heavy a burden.

clue.text: The main course

parts.note: not the central dish of a meal: the main is the sea, and a course is a route across it

explanation.definitionFit: A navigable channel for ships, a route across the main or ocean.

clue.text: Struggling to take some fish by force?

parts.note: wrest means to take, completed here by the words by force
ling is a kind of fish in the cod family

explanation.surface: Someone fights to grab fish by sheer force.
explanation.walkthrough: To wrest is to take by force; 'by force' at the end completes that sense, with LING placed after.
explanation.definitionFit: Grappling, wrestling, fighting to overcome something.

clue.text: Spicy stuff for the head girl!

parts.note: nut is slang for the head
Meg is a girl's name, short for Margaret

explanation.surface: Something hot and spicy for the head girl at school.
explanation.definitionFit: A seed grated as a warm spice, used in cooking and baking.

clue.text: Pressed it agitatedly and wouldn't stop

indicators.note: agitatedly means in a shaken, stirred-up way, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone kept jabbing a button in agitation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'agitatedly' rearranges PRESSED IT.
explanation.definitionFit: Carried on obstinately, kept going despite opposition.
